items.title: What Could Blackstone (BX) Gain From Its New Lloyd's Reinsurance Platform?
items.summary: Blackstone (NYSE:BX) and Aon have created Cortina, a new long term Lloyd's reinsurance syndicate named syndicate 1956. Cortina is designed to provide multi year reinsurance capacity within the Lloyd's market for institutional insurance and risk transfer clients. The platform expands Blackstone's insurance focused capital deployment, adding a dedicated structure for long duration reinsurance commitments. items.summary: Blackstone reported Q3 2026 results showing a slight revenue decline, alongside 6.2% growth in fee-related earnings and 10.2% growth in assets under management.
